test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man receives Rs. 6,500 per month as salary. He saves 20% of his salary every month. His expenditure per month is:
solution:
**Given:**

Monthly salary = 6500

Saving percentage = 20%

**Concept used:**

Expenditure = Saving × ( 100 - Saving)/100

**Calculation:**

Expenditure = Saving × ( 100 - Saving)/100

⇒ Expenditure = 6500 × ( 100 - 20)/100

⇒ Expenditure = 65 × 80

⇒ Expenditure = 5200

**∴ Expenditure is Rs. 5200**
